title: Warm Crisp Middle Eastern Lentils Mujadara
description: A hearty and flavorful Middle Eastern dish featuring lentils, crispy onions, and pomegranate molasses, perfect for a brunch gathering
instructions: Rinse the lentils and soak them in water for 30 minutes, then drain and set aside
In a large pot, bring the lentils and 2 cups of water to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
While the lentils are cooking, heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the sliced onions, cooking until crispy and golden brown
Add the pomegranate molasses, salt, black pepper, and sumac to the skillet with the onions and stir to combine
Once the lentils are cooked, stir in the onion and pomegranate molasses mixture
Smoke the lentil mixture with binchotan-charcoal for 5 minutes to give it a smoky flavor
Serve the mujadara hot, garnished with additional sumac and pomegranate molasses if desired
